scope: Four controlled pages calibrate plain native-button physical Space only. Shared HTML/name and repeated complete action sequences are deliberate; all overlap is recorded. No unsupported control role, changing pressed/expanded/name/help, VO activation, task-generalization or queue/timing claim. Two reverse-entry contexts reserved separately before these observations.

plan.sourceState: Model JS comes from the retained, clean b94ed5b (cached evaluator-target getter added without changing speech rules) tarball. Observer/generator source hashes describe the collection worktree with earlier pending diagnostics; these do not identify the model source.
plan.stationaryCursorChords: Observe separately; editing caret positions are state, not whole-object navigation.
plan.question: Does physical Space on a plain native button that disables itself emit a receipt, and does a named form change it?
plan.hypothesis: Existing task observations suggest silence rather than an object fallback. Hold label/action/result fixed, vary enabled versus disabled and bare versus named form. This is calibration with known history overlap, not an independent evaluation.
plan.protocol: Freeze exact clean baseline b94ed5b model, actual inputs, previous contexts, independent states and cursor/CDP observations before both Native profiles. Keep unsupported/multiple-event windows rather than silently replacing their inputs. Source disabled/enabled checks are fixture health, not user-task success.
plan.inputPolicy: Use only actual model diagnostic inputs and independently mapped renderer identities. Preserve every unsupported activation reason, fallback and Native receipt. Before/after Native states and visible target are separate from keyboard focus. Do not learn from actual speech as an input.
plan.limits: Four controlled pages calibrate plain native-button physical Space only. Shared HTML/name and repeated complete action sequences are deliberate; all overlap is recorded. No unsupported control role, changing pressed/expanded/name/help, VO activation, task-generalization or queue/timing claim. Two reverse-entry contexts reserved separately before these observations.

acquisition.scope: New acquisition after a terminal zero-action navigation failure. Original plan/ready/model/predictions copied byte-for-byte; effective observer hashes below override the old host navigation helper hash only. Both successful profiles finish before source result inspection.

transferReservation.scope: After inspecting practical task failures, but before the new self-disable calibration Native observations or engine correction. Different contexts and full histories fixed; now reserve for a subsequent corrected-model first evaluation.

healthProbe.scope: Known marker-page environment probe only; no experimental task keys or outcomes.
healthProbe.error: Error: axdump: no AXWebArea in the Safari window. Chrome exposes its web tree only while an assistive technology is active (VoiceOver on).

escapeProbe.scope: Known marker-page recovery after Native Safari Tab Overview; no experimental task keys or outcomes.

toggleProbe.scope: Known marker-page recovery using independently observed Safari Tab Overview toolbar button; no experimental task action.
toggleProbe.toggle: button 3 of toolbar 1 of window Community workspace of application process Safari

recovery.observerChange: Safari front-document URL can be missing in Tab Overview; navigate the current tab directly. Exit the independently observed Tab Overview with its toolbar button, then require the known marker document AX URL/body. No VoiceOver restart. Original failed attempt and snapshots unchanged.

environment.observationProtocol: host-receipts-v10: requested AX document URL/body gate with raw navigation probes; NSWorkspace active-application guard; wire request/ack, bounded listen, AX start/end, native selection, snapshot-local equality IDs, heading disclosure level, cell index ranges/header-reference IDs and geometry and bounded native custom-content archives (AX schema v7); isolated visible VO overlay paired captures enabled; preserve page-load and late receipts; no speech completion or logical-cursor identity claim

summary.scope: Speech formatter on caller-owned fixed targets. Full Speech compares a main/hint candidate sequence, not a native queue scheduler. No Navigation, State Accuracy or Task Success evaluation. Bounded host receipt attribution does not prove native completion.
